{{recipesummary|category=Pasta recipes|servings=4|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Italy|Italian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] 

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] freshly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 cups [[cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Tomato|sun-dried tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Julienne|julienned]]
* 1½ cups [[Cookbook:Marinara Sauce|marinara sauce]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]], to taste
* Granulated garlic, to taste
* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] fresh [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Pecorino Romano Cheese|Pecorino Romano cheese]]
* 1 pound penne [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] cooked al dente and drained

==Procedure==

# Heat olive oil in a large pot over high heat.
# Add garlic, and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until it just begins to brown (be careful not to burn garlic), about 1 minute.
# Add cream and sun-dried tomatoes, and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add marinara sauce.
# Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and is reduced by one-fourth.
# Season with salt, pepper and granulated garlic.
# [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in spinach and Romano, and heat just until spinach is wilted and cheese melted.
# [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] with pasta and serve hot.
